title: tulista × bicarinata

Research suggests that Haworthia × truncata may have several health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Haworthia × truncata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including potential uses in wound healing and antimicrobial applications.
